item.name: Account Creation & Account Deletion (Toqa Adel)
1. Create-Register User Account
TC-01 | Create account - valid data in all fields

request.description:
**TC-01** | Priority: High | Test type: Request Configuration, Positive / Functional, Response Validation

**Description:**
1. verify that request method should be POST
2. verify that request URL is correct
3. verify that request body is "x-www-form-urlencoded"
4. verify that all parameters are exist
5. Ensure that pre-request validation completed
6. Create a new account with valid data in all fields
7. verify that HTTP status should be 200 OK
8. verify that response time is less than 2000 ms
9. verify that response written in JSON
10. verify that response contains responseCode and message
11. Verify the create response has the correct data types
12. Verify the create response does not expose the password or personal data

**Body / input:**
user data: name: yousef, email: yousef.test@gmail.com, password: yousef123, title: Mr, birth_date: 20, birth_month: 10, birth_year: 2000, firstname: Yousef, lastname: Ahmed, company: ABC Company, address1: Cairo Street, address2: Nasr City, country: Egypt, zipcode: 11765, state: Cairo, city: Cairo, mobile_number: 01012345678

**Expected result:**
1. Request method is POST
2. request URL is correct
3. request body is "x-www-form-urlencoded"
4. All parameters are present in the request
5. Pre-request validation completes successfully
6. Returns responseCode 201 and message 'User created!'
7. HTTP status is 200 OK
8. Response time is less than 2000 ms
9. Response is returned in JSON format
10. Response contains responseCode and message
11. responseCode is a number and message is a string
12. Response contains only responseCode and message

**Expected response code:** 201 Created (body responseCode) / 200 OK (HTTP status)

**Expected JSON response:**
```
{
    "responseCode": 201,
    "message": "User created!"
}
```
